clips.why: the user's second sheet (Attachments/Salazar/Walkright2, ludo.ai, 7 x 7, 79 ms a frame), 2026-10-17. As drawn, the boot on the ground climbs 12-19 px in the cell during each stance and drops back (frames 3-22: 613 -> 601, 28-48: 617 -> 598), so with the card's feet fixed he floated off the ground and fell back. Each frame moved up / down by whole pixels (no resampling) so the boot standing on the ground sits on row 610 in every frame (scratchpad align_sole.py: lowest row of a solid boot 16 rows tall, which skips the opaque contact-shadow ghosts under frames 23-24 / 46-47). v02 (the first sheet) stays in content/sprites
